facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.get_observation_by_space: request an observation from a named space using env.observation['Autophase'] on a reset CompilerGym environment
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.list_observation_spaces: list all available observation space IDs via env.observation.spaces.keys() after resetting the environment
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.get_observation_space_spec: get the gym Box spec for a space using env.observation.spaces['Autophase'].space

facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.add_derived_observation_space: register a new derived observation space from an existing base space using add_derived_space()

facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.create_observation_space_from_proto: create an ObservationSpaceSpec from a protocol buffer using the from_proto class method
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.create_derived_observation_space: create a derived observation space with a custom translate callback using make_derived_space
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.check_observation_space_equality: check if two ObservationSpaceSpec instances are equal by comparing id, index, space, and flags
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.hash_observation_space: hash an ObservationSpaceSpec instance by its index for use in sets and dicts
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.inspect_observation_space_repr: inspect the string representation of an ObservationSpaceSpec showing its id

facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.get_reward_for_space: get the reward value for a named reward space using env.reward[space_name]
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.reset_reward_view: reset the RewardView and all registered reward spaces for a new benchmark episode
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.add_reward_space: add a new Reward space to the RewardView so it can be queried by name
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.inspect_reward_spaces: inspect the available reward spaces and their range via env.reward.spaces
facebookresearch_compilergym/compiler_gy.call_reward_by_name: call a dynamically bound reward method by name such as env.reward.codesize()
